billing_assumption.basis: Kaggle T4 machine shape is listed as T4 x2; quota billing multiplier is unverified, so budget conservatively for two GPU-seconds per wall-second.

checkpoint_preservation: Fit writes model_ep2.pt, model.pt, provenance, history, and training_state as declared artifacts. The bootstrap persists pipeline status after every completed stage; on timeout/error it leaves current and prior stage outputs in Kaggle working output for terminal collection. A partial run is not marked complete.
concurrent_job_precondition: must be freshly checked by root immediately before release/dispatch
dispatch_policy: Require a fresh root release, zero reserved quota, and no concurrent owned Kaggle jobs. R3 reuses only the verified R2 profile, then runs the unchanged fit and fit-train FP32 export. The fit and export workers each perform their own portable input verification; each must fit its cap. The two remaining predictions are deferred to a saved-checkpoint successor after terminal collection and a fresh quota review. Before each worker, reserve its cap plus finalization against quota-derived and provider deadlines; fail closed on memory admission.

profile_reuse.validation_required: exact trainer argv/environment/input hashes plus matching source_snapshot hashes and successful profile result/guard

quota_snapshot.source_receipt: Kaggle API get_accelerator_quota_statistics, queried after R2 terminal collection
